en.name: Lard
en.summary: Commercially rendered lard keeps 8 months in the pantry, sealed and cool. Home-rendered lard, or any jar you have been dipping into, belongs in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where 1–3 months is the working figure. Frozen at −18 °C (0 °F) it holds 12 months.
en.pantry: 8 months from purchase for a commercially rendered, filtered block, kept cool, dark, dry and sealed — that is the standard figure for a solid shortening and commercial lard behaves that way. Home-rendered lard is a different proposition: it carries traces of water and meat solids that commercial rendering strips out, and those are what turn it. If your lard is cloudy at the bottom of the jar, smells of pork rather than of almost nothing, or was made in your own kitchen, refrigerate it instead of leaving it in the cupboard.
en.fridge: 1–3 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, which is the right default for home-rendered lard and for any jar you have been dipping into. Read that span as a judgement rather than a measurement: the only published figure for a rendered animal fat is the shorter one for duck fat, and this is our stretch of it for clean, well-strained lard. Keep it in a sealed jar and use a clean spoon — flour, salt and browned meat dropped back into the jar are the fastest way to turn good lard. Rancidity is oxidation, not spoilage: it makes the fat taste of old paint and it cannot be cooked out.
en.freezer: 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F), and for cooking purposes frozen lard keeps essentially indefinitely, because cold slows oxidation and oxidation is the only thing happening to it. That figure is our own rather than a published one. Freeze it in usable portions — an ice-cube tray, then a bag — so you can take a spoonful at a time without thawing a whole jar and refreezing the rest.
en.thawing: Take out a frozen portion and drop it into a hot pan, or let it soften in the fridge. Do not thaw a whole jar on the counter and refreeze what is left; portion it before it goes in.
spoilage: A stale, old-paint or crayon smell — rancid fat, and it cannot be cooked out.
A bitter or metallic taste in pastry or anything fried in it.
Yellow patches on a fat that should be white, or mould around the rim.
Water separating out beneath the fat, usually from lard that was not strained properly.
tips: Strain home-rendered lard hot through muslin; meat solids are what turn it.
Always use a clean dry spoon and never one that has been in a pan.
Freeze in portions rather than keeping one large jar in use for months.
Leaf lard, from around the kidneys, is the mildest and the best for pastry.

faq.a: 8 months in the pantry for a commercially rendered block, 1–3 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for home-rendered, or 12 months frozen at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Does lard need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: A sealed commercial block does not. Home-rendered lard does, because it still carries water and meat solids that commercial rendering removes.

faq.q: Can you cook rancidity out of lard?
faq.a: No. Rancidity is oxidation of the fat itself, and heating it only makes the taste more obvious. Throw it out.

zh.name: 豬油
zh.summary: 市售精煉豬油密封放陰涼處可放 8 個月。自家熬的豬油，或任何你一直在挖的那罐，該放 4 °C 以下冷藏，工作上的數字是 1～3 個月。−18 °C 冷凍則是 12 個月。
zh.pantry: 市售精煉、過濾過的豬油磚，自購買日起 8 個月，要陰涼、避光、乾燥、密封——這是固態酥油的標準數字，而市售豬油的表現就是這樣。自家熬的豬油則是另一回事：它帶著商業精煉會去掉的微量水分和肉屑，而那些正是讓它變質的東西。如果你的豬油罐底混濁、聞得出明顯的豬味（而不是幾乎沒有味道），或它本來就是你自己在廚房熬的，那就請冷藏，不要放櫃子。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下 1～3 個月，這是自家熬豬油、以及任何你一直在挖的那罐的正確預設。請把這個區間讀成判斷而不是量測：唯一有公布數字的熬製動物油脂是鴨油，而且更短；這裡是我們針對乾淨、確實濾過的豬油把它往上延伸的結果。請裝密封罐、用乾淨湯匙取用——麵粉、鹽和焦掉的肉屑掉回罐子裡，是讓一罐好豬油最快變質的方式。油耗是氧化，不是腐敗：它會讓油脂帶著陳年油漆味，而且煮不掉。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12 個月；就烹調用途而言，冷凍的豬油幾乎可以無限期保存，因為低溫拖慢氧化，而氧化是它身上唯一在發生的事。這個數字是我們自己的判斷，不是公布的數據。請分成好用的份量冷凍——製冰盒凍好再裝袋——這樣要一匙拿一匙，不必整罐解凍再凍回去。
zh.thawing: 拿一份出來直接丟進熱鍋，或放冷藏回軟。不要整罐放檯面解凍、剩下的再凍回去；冷凍前就先分好份量。
spoilage: 聞起來陳、像舊油漆或蠟筆味——那是油耗，而且煮不掉。
做出來的酥皮或炸物帶苦味或金屬味。
本該雪白的油脂出現黃斑，或罐口長霉。
油層下面析出水，通常是沒有確實過濾造成的。
tips: 自家熬的要趁熱用紗布過濾；讓它變質的就是那些肉屑。
一律用乾淨的乾湯匙，絕對不要用碰過鍋子的那支。
分份量冷凍，不要讓同一大罐用上好幾個月。
腰邊的板油最溫和，也最適合做酥皮。

faq.a: 市售精煉豬油放櫃子 8 個月；自家熬的放 4 °C 以下冷藏 1～3 個月；冷凍 −18 °C 下 12 個月。
未開封的市售油磚不用。自家熬的需要，因為它仍帶著商業精煉會去掉的水分和肉屑。

faq.q: 油耗的豬油煮一煮可以救回來嗎？
faq.a: 不行。油耗是油脂本身的氧化，加熱只會讓那個味道更明顯。請丟掉。
